convertedFacts.logicSummary:
Inputs:
- price: "Home price", number, starts at 400000, 100000 to 2000000, step 10000
- downPayment: "Down payment", percent, starts at 20, 0 to 50, step 1, in %
- mortgageRate: "Mortgage rate", percent, starts at 6.5, 2 to 12, step 0.1
- monthlyRent: "Monthly rent", number, starts at 2200, 500 to 10000, step 50
- rentGrowth: "Rent increase", percent, starts at 3, 0 to 10, step 0.5
- appreciation: "Price growth", percent, starts at 5, -5 to 15, step 0.5
- years: "Years", variable integer, 1 to 30, in years
- city: "City", choice of Austin / Denver / Boston, starts at option 0
- hoa: "Has HOA fees", toggle, starts off
Outputs:
- rentCost: "Cost of renting", currency = monthlyRent * 12 * ((1 + rentGrowth / 100) ^ years - 1) / (rentGrowth / 100 + 0.000001)
- loan: "Loan", currency = price * (1 - downPayment / 100)
- buyCost: "Cost of buying", currency = loan * mortgageRate / 100 * years + price * downPayment / 100 - (price * (1 + appreciation / 100) ^ years - price) + (city == 'Boston' ? 3000 : 1500) * years + hoa * 200 * 12 * years
- difference: "Buying saves", currency = rentCost - buyCost
- buyIsBetter: "Buy?", toggle = difference > 0
convertedFacts.outline:
Rent or Buy: Over 10 years, buying costs less than renting if prices grow 5% a year.
- hero #block-0 ref difference
- chart #block-1 ref rentCost, buyCost over years "Cost over time"
- section #block-2 "Buying"
  - field #block-2-0 ref price
  - slider #block-2-1 ref downPayment
  - slider #block-2-2 ref mortgageRate
  - picker #block-2-3 ref city
  - toggle #block-2-4 ref hoa
- section #block-3 "Renting"
  - field #block-3-0 ref monthlyRent
  - slider #block-3-1 ref rentGrowth
- facts #block-4 "The market"
  Prices rose fast.
  • Median price: $412,000
  • Typical rent: $2,100
- paragraph #block-5
  Buying wins if you stay {years} years: {buyIsBetter}.
- section #auto-inputs
  - slider #auto-input-5 ref appreciation
- section #auto-outputs
  - metric #auto-output-1 ref loan
  - metric #auto-output-4 ref buyIsBetter
related: Mortgage rates, Renting vs owning, Home equity
